chapters.screen: Random Forest. One deep tree draws a patchy, over-confident map. A random forest grows many trees, each on a different bootstrap sample of passengers, and averages their probabilities. Watch the patchwork smooth out as trees are added.
chapters.spoken: Random Forest. One deep tree draws a patchy, over-confident map. A random forest grows many trees, each on a different bootstrap sample of passengers, and averages their probabilities. Watch the patchwork smooth out as trees are added.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: One tree on its own bootstrap sample: hard-edged boxes, many of them 0% or 100%. Validation accuracy 73%.
chapters.spoken: One tree on its own bootstrap sample: hard-edged boxes, many of them 0% or 100%. Validation accuracy 73%.

chapters.screen: Each frame adds already-fitted trees and re-averages: nothing is optimised here. The panel shows the newest tree alone; the maps show the average of all trees so far.
chapters.spoken: Each frame adds already-fitted trees and re-averages: nothing is optimised here. The panel shows the newest tree alone; the maps show the average of all trees so far.

chapters.screen: 50 trees: train accuracy 87%, validation 75% (one tree alone: 73%).
chapters.spoken: 50 trees: train accuracy 87%, validation 75% (one tree alone: 73%).

chapters.screen: For an unseen passenger each tree gives its own P(survive); the forest reports the average of all the votes.
chapters.spoken: For an unseen passenger each tree gives its own chance of survival; the forest reports the average of all the votes.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: A forest averages many trees' terraces, so each sheet is a staircase of many small steps. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: A forest averages many trees' terraces, so each sheet is a staircase of many small steps. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 81% with every input against 78% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 81% with every input against 78% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: Averaging many different over-fitted trees cancels much of their noise and softens their certainty. Limitation: a forest is slow to inspect and far less readable than one tree, and its training accuracy flatters it: judge it on held-out passengers.
chapters.spoken: Averaging many different over-fitted trees cancels much of their noise and softens their certainty. Limitation: a forest is slow to inspect and far less readable than one tree, and its training accuracy flatters it: judge it on held-out passengers.
